acceptance_matrix.case: runtime.observe answers frame id, captured_at, size, orientation and explicit unavailable app/keyboard on the fixture runtime
screen.marks + screen.tap on a session id; tap after rotation answers mark_stale naming the size change and taps nothing
WDA XML becomes hierarchy nodes with scaled pixel bounds, editable/clickable flags and focus
iPhone point size is requested once per geometry epoch; a changed MJPEG frame size or rotate refreshes it; pinch sends two pointer sources
runtime.actions: text after tap waits for focus; focus never appearing fails the step with nothing typed; partial failure lists applied and skipped steps; deadline and cancellation are bounded
OCR cache answers an unchanged frame without a tesseract run and a changed frame with one
benchmark runner writes p50/p95 per case with evidence=fixture and keeps failed trials
handoff request survives a new process, completes only through an explicit person action, resume answers a fresh observation
device.resolve: curly apostrophe and emoji names match exactly; two candidates answer device_ambiguous
gpx.validate rejects external entities and oversized files; preview orders untimed points; play job pauses, resumes, loops and cancels on a fake console
report draft masks secrets and home, lists attachments with digests and a redaction receipt, sends nothing
